answer: nadir kernel prism: every identity locks a kernel deposit of 500, then pays a prism fee of 50 times its queue number in its funding cluster, so the first fake pays 50, the tenth 500 and the hundredth 5,000; ten fakes cost 2,750 and a hundred cost 252,500. New clusters do not help: each needs its own 500 kernel deposit, and the nadir shard price rises as more kernels lock.
